verdict.rationale: Clear dev-server and build-tool error messages are a fair question for a framework ecosystem, so the axis applies. The pack shows only a bare 'Error Reference' page title, with nothing saying the dev server or build tooling emits clear, actionable errors. The one on-topic community report describes going 'from one unclear error to another' while configuring Vue's build tooling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get clear, actionable error messages from the dev server and build tool when something breaks
